in_sanskrit.name: Sharvati
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Wealth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sharvati एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Sharvati is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sharva', which means 'God of Love'. The suffix '-ati' denotes a goddess. Sharvati is thus the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and abundance.
